sources.institution: Rothman, K.J., Greenland, S., & Lash, T.L. (2008). Modern Epidemiology (3rd ed.)

Rigorous mathematical formulation of risk ratios, odds ratios, Mantel-Haenszel methods, and binary regression models

sources.institution: Breslow, N.E., & Day, N.E. (1980/1987). Statistical Methods in Cancer Research (Vols. 1 & 2)
sources.role: Definitive reference for case-control design, matching, conditional logistic regression, and cohort survival methods

sources.institution: Anderson, R.M., & May, R.M. (1991). Infectious Diseases of Humans: Dynamics and Control
sources.role: Classic text for mathematical modeling of epidemics, R_0 derivations, herd immunity, and transmission dynamics
